title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 362 (Sale of assets and recovery of debts due to company)

content.overview: The Official Liquidator shall expeditiously dispose of all the assets whether movable or immovable of the company and recover the debts due to the company. He shall take such steps and employ such means as may be necessary for the realisation of the assets and recovery of debts, including legal proceedings, and shall report the progress to the Tribunal at such intervals as may be prescribed.
content.glance: Official Liquidator must expeditiously dispose of assets and recover debts, employing necessary means including legal proceedings, and report progress to the Tribunal.
content.study: Section 362 imposes an active realisation duty on the Official Liquidator. He must expeditiously dispose of all movable and immovable assets of the company and recover debts due to the company, taking such steps and employing such means as may be necessary, including legal proceedings, and reporting progress to the Tribunal at prescribed intervals.
